baseline_models.focus_anchor: The causative verb at word 2 governs the abode at word 3, and word 4 specifies continuing residence.
baseline_models.mechanism: A caused arrival becomes settled belonging: the addressees are not merely shown a location but installed as residents in a home whose defining condition is continued habitation.

activation_trace.role: The branch's act of lodging at a place supplies arrival and makes the causative verb an installation of residents.
Attachment to and residence in a home turns the named abode from bare location into belonging.
Residence in a place supplies settled duration and fixes the granted lodging as continuing habitation.

changed_reading.before: He placed us in a permanent home.
changed_reading.after: He caused an arrival that becomes settled belonging: they are installed as enduring residents rather than temporary guests.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The residence at word 4 is explicitly sourced from favor at word 6.
baseline_models.mechanism: The source of residence is both excess beyond need and a non-obligatory gift; paired with the support sense of standing, favor is not decorative sentiment but the surplus that grants and keeps the abode viable.

activation_trace.role: What keeps a thing standing supplies the residence's continuing support rather than duration alone.
Excess remaining beyond requirement supplies the abode's character as surplus rather than bare sufficiency.
A freely conferred benefit makes that sustaining surplus a donor's gift rather than a resident's claim.

changed_reading.before: The home is given by divine favor.
changed_reading.after: An unowed surplus both grants the home and supplies what keeps its life permanently standing.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same negated contact verb occurs at words 8 and 12, with toil at word 10 and debility at word 14 as its two subjects.
baseline_models.mechanism: The repeated contact construction creates an access boundary. Active exertion and the weakness left in its wake are not merely absent; neither can reach the residents or produce an effect in them.

activation_trace.role: Direct bodily contact gives the repeated negation a boundary-like literal force.
An effect reaching a person turns denied touch into denied causal impact.
Exertion, hardship, and enervating affliction supply the active burden barred from the residents.
Weakness and spent fatigue supply the depleted condition that is likewise unable to reach them.

changed_reading.before: They experience neither fatigue nor weariness there.
changed_reading.after: Neither exertion nor its residual debility has causal access to them; the abode excludes even first contact with depletion.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The residence noun at word 4 is immediately disambiguated by the negated exhaustion terms at words 10 and 14.
baseline_models.mechanism: One branch of standing can be the halt of a mount that is exhausted and unable to continue. The two fatigue negations prevent permanent residence from sounding like forced stoppage: this is settled continuity without incapacity.

activation_trace.role: Continuing residence supplies the primary settled sense.
Stopping through exhaustion supplies a live negative alternative that the following clauses cancel.
Enervating toil is explicitly excluded, so settledness cannot be a collapse under effort.
Debilitating weakness is excluded, completing the distinction between rest and failed motion.

changed_reading.after: Permanent residence is secure rest without immobilization: continuity remains fully alive and capable, not stalled by exhaustion.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier alternation between opening mercy and unanswerable holding activates a selectively permeable abode: grace is admitted and made resident, while exhaustion is denied even contact.

activation_trace.role: Opening what was closed and widening an entry supplies the positive ingress side of the mechanism.
Tender mercy identifies what the opened route admits.
Holding and confinement supply the counterforce that can block movement, making access itself salient.
Release from restriction lets the causative lodging also carry granted access.
Denied harmful effect supplies the closed side of the abode's selective boundary.

structural_cues: 35:2 alternates what is opened and what is held; 35:35 similarly places gracious admission beside two denied contacts.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opened mercy, irresistible holding, granted access, and denied harmful effect; I infer a boundary that admits gift and bars depletion. A live alternative is that the verses only juxtapose divine control and bodily ease without describing the abode spatially.

changed_reading.before: Grace causes entry, and fatigue happens not to occur inside.
changed_reading.after: The abode itself functions as a selective threshold: opened grace enters and settles, but depletion cannot cross into contact.

context_deltas.mechanism: Measured lives are lengthened and diminished, day and night enter one another, and celestial bodies run to a fixed term. Against that ordered attrition, the abode of residence becomes a non-eroding mode rather than merely a very long interval.

activation_trace.role: Life extended through time supplies a measurable temporal span.
Loss of part of a thing supplies temporal decrement within mortal life.
One period entering another supplies continuous cyclic replacement.
Ongoing movement supplies the cosmos's directed temporal motion.
A fixed terminal time gives that motion a measured limit.
Circulating conditions let the abode carry the background of changing turns that residence overcomes.
Continuing residence supplies the stable condition set against decrement and terminal motion.

structural_cues: The packet moves from recorded lifespan in 35:11 through cosmic cycles in 35:13 to the residence claim in 35:35.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies decrementing lives, interpenetrating periods, motion toward a term, and continuing residence; I infer that permanence changes the residents' temporal regime. The live alternative is endless duration within ordered time rather than existence outside attrition or succession.

changed_reading.after: The residence is not consumed by the decrement, replacement, and terminal motion that measure ordinary existence.

context_deltas.mechanism: Ships move through and cut resistant water in order to seek favor; the focus speakers are then lodged from that same favor. A sought surplus at the end of strenuous motion becomes the substance of settled arrival.

activation_trace.role: A vessel moving through water supplies the mobile platform of the search.
Cutting water in forward motion supplies resistance and directed effort.
Active seeking supplies the journey's purpose.
Freely conferred benefit names what the travelers seek beyond immediate provision.
Lodging at a destination converts the earlier motion into arrival.
Continued residence makes the arrival a final settled condition.

structural_cues: 35:12 orders vessel, water-cutting, seeking, and favor; 35:35 orders favor, lodging, residence, and the end of fatigue.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a material journey seeking favor and a later home sourced from favor; I infer a motion-to-arrival analogy in which the sought surplus becomes settlement. Alternatively, the maritime scene may only illustrate present provision and not map onto the later residence.

changed_reading.before: The home is an isolated gift after earthly life.
changed_reading.after: The home is the settled form of the surplus earlier sought through resistant motion: search terminates in gifted arrival without further fatigue.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sequence distinguishes a trade that does not fail, wages paid in full, and then an increase from favor. Because the focus explicitly sources the residence from favor, the home belongs most sharply to the increment beyond settled compensation.

activation_trace.role: Commerce seeking gain supplies the accounting frame.
Stagnation ending in loss supplies the failure that this commerce escapes.
Completion without deficiency establishes that earned recompense is fully settled first.
Payment for work supplies the category of due compensation.
Growth beyond the completed amount supplies a second, additive stage.
Surplus beyond requirement identifies the increase as excess rather than unpaid wages.
A non-obligatory benefit makes the residence itself part of that additional generosity.

structural_cues: 35:29-30 moves from successful commerce to full wages and only then to increase; 35:35 repeats the source of that increase.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a staged account of full wages followed by increase from favor and later names favor as the home's source; I infer that the home is located in the beyond-wage increment. A live alternative is that favor summarizes the entire reward economy rather than only its excess stage.

changed_reading.before: The residence is reward for faithful work.
changed_reading.after: Work is fully recompensed, but the residence is voiced as the further surplus that no wage account by itself can demand.

context_deltas.mechanism: The inherited trust belongs to a selected plurality internally differentiated as wronging, moderate, and foremost; the narrative then shifts to plural entry and finally 'us' in the residence. Grace can therefore gather unequal trajectories into one inhabited outcome without pretending they earned it identically.

activation_trace.role: Transmission of a book or virtue as inheritance supplies a shared received trust.
Selection of a chosen group supplies the plural community under discussion.
A middle course supplies one distinct trajectory within that community.
Advancing ahead supplies another, non-identical trajectory.
A freely granted benefit supplies the umbrella under which differentiated paths can converge.
Movement into an interior carries the selected plurality across the threshold together.
Being lodged turns plural entry into a common resident condition.

structural_cues: Three repeated subgroup clauses in 35:32 are followed by plural entry in 35:33 and first-person plural residence in 35:35.
The packet does not explicitly resolve whether every subgroup remains the antecedent of the later plurals.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies selection, three unequal paths, plural entry, and plural lodging by favor; I infer convergence without erased differentiation. The live alternative is a narrowed antecedent in which only an admitted subset speaks, so the social breadth remains uncertain.

changed_reading.before: An undifferentiated blessed group reports its home.
changed_reading.after: The plural home can gather inheritors of unequal prior trajectories, with shared residence grounded in favor rather than equal merit.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding praise reports grief actively taken away; the focus then reports toil and weakness unable to touch. Ease has two phases: removal of an already borne inward roughness, followed by prevention of any new depletion.

activation_trace.role: Departure and removal supply an active clearing of a prior condition.
The inward roughness of grief identifies what is first removed.
Denied impact changes repair into continuing protection from renewed harm.
Toil and affliction supply one future source of depletion that cannot arrive.
Residual weakness supplies the other depleted state barred from recurrence.

structural_cues: 35:34 uses an accomplished removal, while 35:35 uses two present negations of contact.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies removed grief followed by present-tense denied contact with toil and weakness; I infer a sequence from cure to prophylaxis. Alternatively, the tense and clause shift may intensify praise without encoding two distinct phases.

changed_reading.before: The residents simply feel no sorrow or fatigue.
changed_reading.after: What they carried is first removed, and the abode then prevents new exertion or debility from ever taking hold.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next scene also withholds an ending: its inhabitants are not finished by death, receive no lightening, cry out, and seek exit. Duration is therefore neutral. The focus residence is desirable because gracious placement and impermeability to harm give permanence its quality.

activation_trace.role: A final decree enacted as death supplies the ending that is withheld in the contrasting condition.
Loss of life and power identifies the unavailable exit from that condition.
Reduction of weight supplies the relief that is also withheld.
Painful punishment supplies the continuing harmful effect that cannot be lightened.
A loud appeal for rescue makes the intolerability of continued residence audible.
Movement out of an interior supplies the exit unsuccessfully requested.
Continuing residence supplies the shared structural feature whose value must be disambiguated.
Exclusion of harmful impact supplies the decisive qualitative difference.

structural_cues: 35:35 and 35:36 both use paired negations, but one denies harmful contact while the other denies both death and relief.
35:37 adds an explicit but unsuccessful request to leave the contrasting interior.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacent unending conditions with opposite experiential effects; I infer that the next scene semantically disambiguates the goodness of residence by quality rather than duration. A live alternative is simple rhetorical contrast without any revision of the residence noun itself.

changed_reading.before: The abode is blessed because it is permanent.
changed_reading.after: Permanence alone is not the blessing; gracious belonging and the impossibility of harmful impact make this permanence habitable rather than inescapable.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later image of heavens and earth continuously held from displacement activates residence as active preservation. The abode remains because divine maintenance prevents its order from slipping; its residents do not bear that maintenance as labor.

activation_trace.role: Continuous holding supplies the preserving force that keeps an ordered domain in place.
Departure from place or condition supplies the displacement being prevented.
Care, preservation, and governance make residence an actively maintained condition.
The support by which a thing remains standing supplies durable habitability.
Changing turns supply the instability that maintained residence withstands.

structural_cues: 35:41 repeats holding around a counterfactual loss of place, making stability an ongoing act rather than a passive property.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies cosmic holding against displacement and focus branches of preservation and support; I infer that the abode's permanence is continuously maintained and that this work is not shifted to its residents. Alternatively, cosmic preservation may illustrate power only, while the focus residence remains a simple duration term.

changed_reading.before: The abode is permanent because it is intrinsically static.
changed_reading.after: Its permanence is an ongoing act of preservation: the domain is held in stable habitability without making its residents sustain it through toil.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier, a heavy bearer cannot transfer even part of its load to another and each moves toward a destination. The focus does not picture relief as someone else carrying the burden; it pictures a destination where burden no longer reaches anyone.

activation_trace.role: A heavy burden supplies the individually borne load that cannot be reassigned.
Being loaded down supplies the pressure prompting an appeal for help.
Bearing an entrusted or culpable load supplies the nontransferable act of carrying.
Becoming toward a final outcome gives the burden-bearing sequence a destination.
Enervating labor supplies the load-effect absent at the destination.
Denied impact marks cessation of burden rather than its displacement onto another bearer.

structural_cues: 35:18 emphatically denies interpersonal transfer of a load before naming a destination; 35:35 emphatically denies the effects of load-bearing at the residence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies nontransferable load-bearing, a destination, and later denied exhaustion; I infer that final relief removes the load's operation rather than outsourcing it. The live alternative is that legal accountability in 35:18 and bodily fatigue in 35:35 remain separate domains.

changed_reading.before: The residents are relieved of work.
changed_reading.after: Their relief is not burden shifted to another creature; at the destination, the burdening relation itself no longer reaches them.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the focus syntax and dominant mapping strongly favor causative lodging. It remains live because the packet explicitly gives the focus consonantal root a second mapped target for ornament and the immediately preceding ayah activates that target with bodily adornment; downstream prose should present it only as secondary wordplay, not replace the lodging sense.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The verb at word 2 has an explicit non-dominant mapping to the same target activated by adornment immediately before it, while word 6 supplies received good.

activation_trace.role: Being furnished with ornament activates adornment immediately before the focus verb.
An ornament encircling the hand makes the prior adornment materially concrete.
A precious bead supplies a second concrete material of investiture.
The focus root's non-dominant ornament target lets lodging resonate as being invested with the abode.
Good reaching someone supports hearing the home itself as a conferred good.

changed_reading.before: He lodged us in the enduring abode.
changed_reading.after: Secondarily, He invested us with the enduring abode: the home itself becomes the culminating adornment and good conferred on its residents.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This competes with the stronger beyond-wage reading and is surprising because favor normally resists entitlement. It remains anchored in the focus verb's branch of an obligation becoming due and in the nearby sequence of full payment plus favor; downstream prose should frame it as a juridical resonance in which the giver creates the claim, never as merit independently binding the giver.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The causative verb at word 2 can activate a falling-due branch, while word 6 explicitly locates the cause in the giver's favor.

activation_trace.role: Full completion supplies a juridical environment of settled obligation.
Payment for work supplies the nearby category of what is due.
A freely conferred addition prevents the juridical reading from becoming independent human entitlement.
An obligation falling due lets the causative verb resonate as making settlement effective or due.
The donor's unowed gift supplies the sole source of the newly effective claim.

changed_reading.before: The residence is either earned compensation or an unowed gift.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, grace itself makes the promised settlement come due: the claim is effective, yet its entire ground remains the giver's prior generosity.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because the ordinary focus noun denotes a home, not defeat circling a group. It remains anchored in that noun's adverse-turn branch and in the later image of evil descending around its own people; downstream prose should label it a spatial reversal, with gracious enclosure replacing hostile encirclement.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The abode noun at word 3 has an adverse-circuit branch, and the repeated contact negation defines what may not penetrate its enclosure.

activation_trace.role: A harmful turn circling and defeating a group supplies the negative enclosure that the abode reverses.
Denied harmful effect makes the new enclosure protective rather than punitive.
Harm descending and encompassing supplies the later explicit geometry of hostile encirclement.
A group bound by belonging identifies those enclosed by the consequence of their own action.

changed_reading.before: The dār is simply the residents' permanent house.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it is a reversed circle: instead of an adverse turn enclosing its people, gracious habitation encloses them while harm cannot enter.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the focus fatigue noun ordinarily names weariness, while its long-pursuit branch is remote. It remains anchored in that supplied branch and is activated by the closing sequence of earthly travel, historical outcome, delay, and appointed term; downstream prose should render it as a secondary temporal image, not a lexical substitution.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The final focus noun at word 14 carries a prolonged-chase branch, while the residence noun at word 4 supplies the settled endpoint.

activation_trace.role: A prolonged chase supplies an extended condition of being driven rather than merely feeling tired.
Settled residence supplies the endpoint at which pursuit ceases.
Travel through the earth supplies ongoing human motion before the endpoint.
A final outcome supplies the terminus disclosed by that travel.
Deferral to a later time supplies the interval during which the endpoint still pursues the traveler.
The fixed terminal time supplies the limit that eventually ends deferral and motion.

changed_reading.before: No weariness is felt after arrival.
changed_reading.after: Secondarily, no long pursuit by travel, consequence, or deferred term reaches them: residence is the end of being driven through time.

strongest_changes: The wage-plus-increase sequence makes the residence most sharply an excess of favor beyond completed compensation.
The immediately following unrelieved condition shows that permanence is neutral until gracious belonging and exclusion of harm make it habitable.
The later holding of heavens and earth turns residence from inert duration into continuously maintained stability whose labor is not borne by residents.
The selected but differentiated inheritors make the first-person plural potentially social: unequal trajectories can converge in one grace-grounded home.
summary.what_was_special: The packet sustained several readings that a conservative synthesis could lose: rest without incapacitating stoppage, a split-root adornment resonance, a competing grace-created due, a reversal of hostile encirclement, and the end of prolonged temporal pursuit.
remaining_uncertainties: The later plural may include all three groups of inheritors or may narrow to an admitted subset.
Non-eroding residence may mean existence outside temporal attrition or endless life within an ordered succession.
The two exhaustion nouns may mark exertion and residual debility as phases, or may function mainly as intensifying near-synonyms.
The ornament, obligation, adverse-circle, and prolonged-pursuit branches are packet-licensed activations, but their audibility in the focus wording remains exploratory.
